'Deal 1 arcane damage to target hero. / Surge - If this deals more than 1 damage, opt 1.'

Surge (CR 8.4.8) reads the damage this card ACTUALLY dealt -- after Amp, prevention and Arcane Barrier, which are exactly what push it past the printed number -- and tests strictly GREATER THAN, which is how every printed Surge is worded. The DEAL runs first so the gate sees this card's damage rather than a previous card's.

Opt is authored rather than left to the card DB: it is in `keywords` because the printed text names it, but here it is the Surge PAYOFF and happens only when the gate holds -- a keyword the engine granted unconditionally would opt on every resolution.
